create_radix_attention_layer: create a RadixAttention layer with configurable heads, head dim, scaling, and quantization config
run_radix_attention_forward: run the RadixAttention forward pass with q, k, v tensors and a ForwardBatch for extend or decode mode
build_attention_type_enum: build an AttentionType enum value (decoder, decoder_bidirectional, encoder_only) for specifying attention mode
run_unified_attention_with_output: run unified_attention_with_output as a custom op that narrows tokens and delegates to the attention backend
test_radix_attention_quantization: test RadixAttention with a quant_config to enable quantized weight handling via quant_method
